name: aegiloc
description: A conservative, deterministic self-healing layer for Playwright Test.
author: Kamen Asenov

scripts.evidence:attest: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js attest --history test-results/aegiloc/history.jsonl --summary test-results/aegiloc/summary.json --out test-results/aegiloc/manifest.json --force
scripts.example:verify: pnpm build && tsc -p examples/basic-playwright/tsconfig.json && playwright test --config=examples/basic-playwright/playwright.config.ts
scripts.example:realistic: node scripts/reset-realistic-demo.mjs && pnpm build && tsc -p examples/realistic-demo/tsconfig.json && playwright test --config=examples/realistic-demo/playwright.config.ts && node dist/cli.js attest --history test-results/realistic-demo/evidence/history.jsonl --summary test-results/realistic-demo/evidence/summary.json --out test-results/realistic-demo/evidence/manifest.json && node dist/cli.js verify --manifest test-results/realistic-demo/evidence/manifest.json && node dist/cli.js view --history test-results/realistic-demo/evidence/history.jsonl --summary test-results/realistic-demo/evidence/summary.json --manifest test-results/realistic-demo/evidence/manifest.json --out test-results/realistic-demo/viewer
scripts.package:check: pnpm build && node scripts/generate-api-snapshot.mjs --check && pnpm package:contracts && node scripts/verify-pack.mjs
scripts.release:check: pnpm format:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm api:snapshot:check && pnpm package:check && pnpm package:reproducible && pnpm supply-chain:sbom && pnpm supply-chain:sbom:check && pnpm test:reporter:parallel && pnpm test && pnpm evidence:verify && pnpm evidence:attest && pnpm evidence:manifest:verify && pnpm governance:evaluate && pnpm test:cross-browser && pnpm example:verify && pnpm example:realistic
scripts.test:expanded: playwright test tests/locator-contracts.spec.ts tests/registry-validation.expanded.spec.ts tests/scoring-boundaries.expanded.spec.ts tests/candidate-contracts.spec.ts tests/safety-contracts.expanded.spec.ts
scripts.test:governance: pnpm build && playwright test --config=playwright.unit.config.ts tests/governance.spec.ts tests/governance-cli.spec.ts tests/governance-ci-contract.spec.ts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm build && playwright test --config=playwright.unit.config.ts tests/api-compatibility.spec.ts tests/audit.spec.ts tests/classification.spec.ts tests/cli.spec.ts tests/evidence.spec.ts tests/evidence-manifest.spec.ts tests/fingerprints.spec.ts tests/governance.spec.ts tests/governance-cli.spec.ts tests/governance-ci-contract.spec.ts tests/modes.spec.ts tests/portfolio-contracts.spec.ts tests/proposals.spec.ts tests/registry.spec.ts tests/registry-schema-parity.spec.ts tests/registry-validation.expanded.spec.ts tests/reporter.spec.ts tests/report-viewer.spec.ts tests/safety-contracts.expanded.spec.ts tests/scoring.spec.ts tests/scoring.property.spec.ts tests/scoring-boundaries.expanded.spec.ts tests/scoring-unicode.spec.ts tests/semantic-eligibility.spec.ts tests/supply-chain.spec.ts
